rationale: Record a single include added to test/test_browser_capture_tree.cpp. The test constructs a std::array and relied on <array> arriving transitively through another header, which holds on the Apple libc++ the required macOS gate builds against and does not hold on the libstdc++ the widened Intel and Linux lanes now run. Adding the direct include makes the translation unit name what it uses. No capture behavior, no Chromium launch or custody path, no captured output, no DesignIR, and no assertion in the file changes; the test compiles the same sources and asserts the same tree. This touches no accepted expansion boundary and no Vellum source authority, so the disposition is watch-only.
